notes: Full public sequence at 1x, one cloud container, ROS 2 Jazzy, 4 vCPUs, the same RKO binary as v1.6.0 to v1.10.0. The host CPU model differs from v1.10.0's (2.30 GHz, not 2.10 GHz; it is v1.9.0's model), so the alignment times are not like-for-like with v1.10.0. localizer.yaml, rko.yaml and points-qos.yaml are byte-identical to v1.10.0's. The harness now also samples the localizer's and RKO's CPU and memory (summary.json 'resources' and 'rko_resources') and subscribes its control node to the clouds to measure pose latency. On the same CPU model, v1.9.0 measured 13 ms at the median and 33-34 ms at p95 (docs/validation/v1.9.0-koide-20261110).
